description.en-US: Benson's essays of 1907, written after his conversion, on religion as seen by a convert and a priest: At a Requiem, intellectual slavery, the sense of the supernatural, Holy Week, the dance as a religious exercise, Low Mass, Benediction, the personality of the Church and death.
description.pt-BR: Os ensaios de Benson (1907), escritos depois da sua conversão, sobre a religião vista por um convertido e padre: Num Réquiem, a escravidão intelectual, o sentido do sobrenatural, a Semana Santa, a dança como exercício religioso, a Missa rezada, a Bênção, a personalidade da Igreja e a morte.

sources.edition: Papers of a Pariah (London: Smith, Elder, 1907), Internet Archive full-text OCR (papersofpariah00bens).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1907, so the text is public domain.
